name: Pretty Monsters
original_name: プリティーモンスターズ
source:
After collapse of an anti-matter conversion furnace 400 years ago, science-based civilization was almost completely annihilated. However, humanity was able to regain former prosperity by domesticating and utilizing flying Primon as means of transport. Fuami is a healthy girl who aims to ride Primon. For that she sets on a journey of practice.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
400年前，一座反物质转换炉崩毁，以科学为基础的文明几乎彻底毁灭。然而，人类驯化并利用会飞的普利蒙作为交通工具，重新获得昔日繁荣。健康活泼的女孩富亚美立志骑乘普利蒙，为此踏上修行之旅。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
